words.sanskrit: atha atah sannyasopanishadam vyakhyasyamah

meaning.en: now we shall explain the teaching on renunciation
meaning.hi: अब हम संन्यास के उपदेश का वर्णन करेंगे

words.sanskrit: yah anukramena sannyasyati sah sannyasto bhavati

meaning.en: whoever renounces in proper order becomes a renunciate
meaning.hi: जो क्रमपूर्वक संन्यास लेता है वही संन्यासी बनता है

words.sanskrit: matram pitaram bharyam putran bandhun anumodayitva

meaning.en: taking leave of mother, father, wife, sons, kinsmen with consent
meaning.hi: माता, पिता, पत्नी, पुत्रों, बन्धुओं से सहमति लेकर विदा लेना

words.sanskrit: vaishvanareshtim nirvapet

meaning.en: he performs the Vaishvanara offering
meaning.hi: वह वैश्वानर आहुति करता है

words.sanskrit: sarvasvam dadyat yajamanasya

meaning.en: he gives away all he owns to the officiants
meaning.hi: वह अपना सब कुछ यजमान के पुरोहितों को दे देता है

words.sanskrit: prana-apana-vyana-udana-samanan sarvan sarveshu samaropayet

meaning.en: he places all the vital breaths into one another, into the fires
meaning.hi: वह सभी प्राणों को परस्पर, अग्नियों में समर्पित करता है

words.sanskrit: sashikhan keshan visrijya yajnopavitam chittva

meaning.en: letting the hair with top-knot loose, cutting the sacred thread
meaning.hi: शिखा-सहित बालों को खोलकर, यज्ञोपवीत काटकर

words.sanskrit: putram drishtva tvam yajnah tvam sarvam iti anumantrayet

meaning.en: looking at his son he declares: you are the sacrifice, you are everything
meaning.hi: पुत्र को देखकर वह कहता है: तू यज्ञ है, तू सब कुछ है

words.sanskrit: yadi aputrah bhavati atmanam eva dhyatva

meaning.en: if he is sonless, meditating on the self alone
meaning.hi: यदि पुत्रहीन है तो केवल आत्मा का ध्यान करके

words.sanskrit: anavekshamanah prachim udichim va disham pravrajet

meaning.en: without looking back, he should set out east or north
meaning.hi: बिना पीछे देखे पूर्व या उत्तर दिशा में चल पड़े

words.sanskrit: trishu varneshu bhikshacharyam charet

meaning.en: he should wander for alms among the three classes
meaning.hi: तीन वर्णों में भिक्षाचर्या करे

words.sanskrit: panipatrena anashanam kuryat

meaning.en: he should eat from the cupped palm as his only vessel
meaning.hi: हथेली को ही पात्र बनाकर भोजन करे

words.sanskrit: aushadhavad ashanam ashniyat

meaning.en: he should take food the way one takes medicine
meaning.hi: औषधि की भाँति भोजन ग्रहण करे

words.sanskrit: yatha-labham ashniyat prana-sandharanartham

meaning.en: he should eat only enough to sustain the breath of life
meaning.hi: केवल प्राण-रक्षा भर जितना मिले उतना खाए

words.sanskrit: krisho bhutva grame ekaratram nagare pancharatram

meaning.en: staying thin, one night in a village, five in a town
meaning.hi: दुबला रहकर गाँव में एक रात, नगर में पाँच रातें

words.sanskrit: chaturo masan varshikan grame va nagare vapi vaset

meaning.en: four months of the rains he may stay in village or town
meaning.hi: वर्षा के चार महीने गाँव या नगर में रह सकता है

words.sanskrit: visirna-vastram valkalam va pratigrihniyat

meaning.en: he should accept a worn cloth or bark garment
meaning.hi: वह फटा वस्त्र या वल्कल स्वीकार करे

words.sanskrit: anyat na pratigrihniyat yadi ashakto bhavati

meaning.en: he should accept nothing more if unable to bear it
meaning.hi: यदि असमर्थ हो तो इससे अधिक न ले

words.sanskrit: kim asya yajnopavitam ka asya shikha katham va asya upasparshanam iti

meaning.en: what is his sacred thread, his top-knot, his water-sipping rite?
meaning.hi: उसका यज्ञोपवीत क्या, शिखा क्या, जलाचमन कैसा?

words.sanskrit: idam eva asya tat yajnopavitam yat atma-dhyanam

meaning.en: his meditation on the self is his sacred thread
meaning.hi: उसका आत्म-ध्यान ही उसका यज्ञोपवीत है

words.sanskrit: vidya shikha

meaning.en: knowledge is his top-knot
meaning.hi: ज्ञान ही शिखा है

words.sanskrit: nirai sarvatra avasthitaih karyam nirvartayan

meaning.en: completing what is needed with water available everywhere
meaning.hi: सर्वत्र उपलब्ध जल से आवश्यक कार्य पूरा करते हुए

words.sanskrit: astamita aditye katham va asya upasparshanam iti

meaning.en: once the sun has set, how does he purify himself?
meaning.hi: सूर्यास्त होने पर वह शुद्धि कैसे करता है?

words.sanskrit: yatha ahani tatha ratrau na asya naktam na divaa

meaning.en: for him night is as day; he has neither night nor day
meaning.hi: उसके लिए रात दिन के समान, न रात न दिन

words.sanskrit: chatvarimshat samskara sampannah

meaning.en: one who has completed the forty life-sacraments
meaning.hi: जिसने चालीस संस्कार पूर्ण किए हों

words.sanskrit: sarvato viraktah chitta-shuddhim etya

meaning.en: detached from everything, having attained purity of mind
meaning.hi: सब कुछ से विरक्त, चित्त-शुद्धि प्राप्त कर

words.sanskrit: asha-asuya-irshya-ahamkaram dagdhva

meaning.en: having burned away hope, envy, jealousy, pride
meaning.hi: आशा, ईर्ष्या, डाह, अहंकार को जलाकर

words.sanskrit: sadhana-chatushtaya sampannah eva sannyastum arhati

meaning.en: only one equipped with the four qualifications is fit to renounce
meaning.hi: चार साधनों से युक्त ही संन्यास के योग्य है

words.sanskrit: sannyasam nishchayam kritva punah na cha karoti yah

meaning.en: one who resolves on renunciation and then does not follow through
meaning.hi: जो संन्यास का निश्चय कर फिर नहीं करता

words.sanskrit: sah kuryat krichchhram matram tu punah sannyastum arhati

meaning.en: he must perform a hard penance to be fit again
meaning.hi: उसे कठिन प्रायश्चित्त कर पुनः योग्य बनना पड़ता है

words.sanskrit: sannyasam patayet yah tu

meaning.en: one who causes another's renunciation to fall
meaning.hi: जो किसी के संन्यास को गिराता है

words.sanskrit: patitam nyasayet tu yah

meaning.en: one who re-establishes a fallen person
meaning.hi: जो पतित को पुनः स्थापित करता है

words.sanskrit: sannyasa-vighna-karta cha

meaning.en: one who obstructs another's renunciation
meaning.hi: जो संन्यास में विघ्न डालता है

words.sanskrit: trin etan patitan viduh

meaning.en: these three are known as fallen
meaning.hi: इन तीनों को पतित जाना जाता है

words.sanskrit: sannyasam patayet yah tu patitam nyasayet tu yah

meaning.en: (repeated) one who fells renunciation, one who reinstates the fallen
meaning.hi: (पुनरावृत्ति) जो संन्यास गिराता है, जो पतित को स्थापित करता है

words.sanskrit: sannyasa-vighna-karta cha trin etan patitan viduh

meaning.en: (repeated) and the obstructer -- these three are fallen
meaning.hi: (पुनरावृत्ति) और विघ्नकर्ता -- ये तीनों पतित हैं

words.sanskrit: shandah patitah angavikalah straino badhirah arbhakah mukah

meaning.en: eunuch, fallen, disabled, woman-ruled, deaf, child, mute
meaning.hi: नपुंसक, पतित, अंगविकल, स्त्री-अधीन, बहरा, बालक, गूँगा

words.sanskrit: pashandah chakri lingi kushthi vaikhanasa-harad-vijau

meaning.en: heretic, disc-bearer, sect-marked, leper, vaikhanasa hermit
meaning.hi: नास्तिक, चक्रधारी, सम्प्रदाय-चिह्नित, कुष्ठी, वैखानस

words.sanskrit: bhritaka-adhyapakah shipivishtah anagnikah nastikah

meaning.en: paid teacher, malformed organ, fireless, unbeliever
meaning.hi: वेतनभोगी अध्यापक, विकृत अंग, अग्निहीन, नास्तिक

words.sanskrit: vairagyavantah api ete na sannyasarhah

meaning.en: even with dispassion, these are not fit for renunciation
meaning.hi: वैराग्यवान होने पर भी ये संन्यास योग्य नहीं

words.sanskrit: sannyastah yadyapi mahavakyopadeshe na adhikarinah

meaning.en: even a renunciate in these categories cannot be taught the great sayings
meaning.hi: संन्यासी भी इन श्रेणियों में हो तो महावाक्य सिखाने का अधिकारी नहीं

words.sanskrit: arudha-patita-apatyam

meaning.en: one whose lineage has a fallen ascetic
meaning.hi: जिसके वंश में पतित तपस्वी रहा हो

words.sanskrit: kunakhi shyava-dantakah

meaning.en: deformed nails, blackened teeth
meaning.hi: विकृत नाखून, काले दाँत

words.sanskrit: kshibah tatha angavikalah

meaning.en: habitually intoxicated, likewise disabled
meaning.hi: आदतन नशेड़ी, वैसे ही अंगविकल

words.sanskrit: na eva sannyastum arhati

meaning.en: none of these are fit to renounce
meaning.hi: इनमें से कोई संन्यास योग्य नहीं

words.sanskrit: samprati avasitanam cha mahapatakinam tatha

meaning.en: those finally fallen from duty, and great sinners
meaning.hi: अन्ततः कर्तव्य से पतित, और महापातकी

words.sanskrit: vratyanam abhishastanam sannyasam na karayet

meaning.en: those without sacred fire, the formally cursed -- renunciation not given
meaning.hi: व्रात्य, अभिशप्त को संन्यास न दिया जाए

words.sanskrit: vrata-yajna-tapo-dana-homa-svadhyaya-varjitam

meaning.en: one devoid of vows, sacrifice, austerity, charity, fire-offering, study
meaning.hi: व्रत, यज्ञ, तप, दान, हवन, स्वाध्याय से रहित

words.sanskrit: satya-shaucha-paribhrashtam sannyasam na karayet

meaning.en: fallen from truth and purity -- renunciation not given
meaning.hi: सत्य और शुचिता से भ्रष्ट को संन्यास न दिया जाए

words.sanskrit: ete na arhanti sannyasam aturena vina kramam

meaning.en: these do not qualify for the proper order except in dire straits
meaning.hi: ये आतुरता के सिवा क्रमिक संन्यास के योग्य नहीं

words.sanskrit: om bhuh svaha iti shikham utpatya

meaning.en: saying Om bhuh svaha, plucking out the top-knot
meaning.hi: ॐ भूः स्वाहा कहकर शिखा उखाड़कर

words.sanskrit: yashah balam jnanam vairagyam medham prayacchati iti yajnopavitam chittva

meaning.en: cutting the thread, asking it grant fame, strength, knowledge, dispassion, understanding
meaning.hi: यश, बल, ज्ञान, वैराग्य, बुद्धि माँगते हुए यज्ञोपवीत काटकर

words.sanskrit: sannyastam maya iti trivaram abhimantrayet

meaning.en: he declares three times: I have renounced
meaning.hi: तीन बार कहे: मैंने संन्यास लिया

words.sanskrit: sannyasinam dvijam drishtva sthanat chalati bhaskarah

meaning.en: seeing a Brahmin renunciate, the sun moves from its place
meaning.hi: ब्राह्मण संन्यासी को देखकर सूर्य अपने स्थान से हिलता है

words.sanskrit: esha me mandalam bhitva param brahma adhigacchati

meaning.en: he, breaking my orb, attains the highest Brahman
meaning.hi: यह मेरे मण्डल को भेदकर परम ब्रह्म को प्राप्त करता है

words.sanskrit: shashtim kulani atitani shashtim gamikani cha

meaning.en: sixty generations past and sixty to come
meaning.hi: साठ पीढ़ियाँ बीत चुकीं, साठ आने वाली

words.sanskrit: kulani uddharate prajnah sannyastam iti yah vadet

meaning.en: the wise one who declares renunciation redeems the lineages
meaning.hi: जो संन्यास घोषित करता है वह कुलों का उद्धार करता है

words.sanskrit: ye cha santanajah doshah ye doshah dehasambhavah

meaning.en: flaws from descendants, flaws from his own body
meaning.hi: वंशजों से उपजे दोष, शरीर से उपजे दोष

words.sanskrit: praishagnih nirdahet sarvan tusharin iva kanchanam

meaning.en: the fire of final passing burns all, as fire purifies gold
meaning.hi: प्रैषाग्नि सबको भस्म करे, जैसे अग्नि सोने को शुद्ध करती है

words.sanskrit: sakha ma gopaya iti dandam parigrihniyat

meaning.en: "friend, protect me" -- he takes up the staff
meaning.hi: "मित्र, रक्षा करो" कहकर दण्ड ग्रहण करे

words.sanskrit: dandam tu vanavam saumyam satvacham samaparvakam

meaning.en: the staff of bamboo, gentle, bark-on, even-jointed
meaning.hi: दण्ड बाँस का, सौम्य, छाल-सहित, समान-गाँठ

words.sanskrit: punyasthala samutpannam nana-kalmasha-shodhitam

meaning.en: grown in a sacred place, cleansed of every blemish
meaning.hi: पवित्र स्थान में उगा, सब दोषों से शुद्ध

words.sanskrit: adagdham ahataih kitaih parvagranthi virajitam

meaning.en: unspoiled by insects, marked by its joints
meaning.hi: कीड़ों से अक्षत, गाँठों से चिह्नित

words.sanskrit: nasadaghnam shirastulyam bhruvoh va bibhriyat yatih

meaning.en: the ascetic should hold it to nose-level or forehead-level
meaning.hi: तपस्वी उसे नाक या मस्तक के स्तर तक धारण करे

words.sanskrit: dandatmanoh tu samyogah sarvatha tu vidhiyate

meaning.en: the union of staff and self is enjoined in every way
meaning.hi: दण्ड और आत्मा का सम्बन्ध सब प्रकार से विहित है

words.sanskrit: na dandena vina gacchet ishukshepatrayam budhah

meaning.en: the wise should not go even three steps without the staff
meaning.hi: बुद्धिमान दण्ड बिना तीन क़दम भी न जाए

words.sanskrit: jagajjivanam jivanadharabhutam mate mam antrayasva sarvasaumye iti kamandalum parigrihya

meaning.en: "life of the world, support of life, mother, favor me, be kind to all" -- taking up the water-pot
meaning.hi: "जगत का जीवन, जीवन का आधार, माता, मुझ पर प्रसन्न हो" -- जलपात्र लेकर

words.sanskrit: yogapattabhishikto bhutva yathasukham viharet

meaning.en: consecrated with the robe of yoga, he wanders at ease
meaning.hi: योग-वस्त्र से अभिषिक्त होकर वह सुखपूर्वक विचरे

words.sanskrit: tyaja dharmam adharmam cha ubhe satya-anrite tyaja

meaning.en: give up dharma and adharma; give up both truth and falsehood
meaning.hi: धर्म-अधर्म त्यागो; सत्य-असत्य दोनों त्यागो

words.sanskrit: ubhe satya-anrite tyaktva yena tyajasi tat tyaja

meaning.en: having given up truth and falsehood, give up the means by which you gave them up
meaning.hi: सत्य-असत्य त्यागकर, जिससे त्यागा उसे भी त्यागो

words.sanskrit: vairagya-sannyasi jnana-sannyasi jnana-vairagya-sannyasi karma-sannyasi iti chaturvidhyam upagatah

meaning.en: renunciates are of four kinds: through dispassion, knowledge, both, or formal duty
meaning.hi: संन्यासी चार प्रकार के: वैराग्य से, ज्ञान से, दोनों से, कर्म से

words.sanskrit: drishta-anushravika-vishaya-vaitrishnyam etya prak-punya-karma-visheshat sannyastah sah vairagya-sannyasi

meaning.en: one who reaches indifference to the seen and heard, through prior exceptional merit, is the dispassion-renunciate
meaning.hi: देखे-सुने के प्रति उदासीन, पूर्व असाधारण पुण्य से, वैराग्य-संन्यासी है

words.sanskrit: shastra-jnanat papa-punya-loka-anubhava-shravanat prapancha-uparatah

meaning.en: through scriptural knowledge and hearing of merit-sin and their worlds, one ceases from the outward show
meaning.hi: शास्त्र-ज्ञान और पुण्य-पाप-लोक सुनने से बाह्य-प्रपंच से निवृत्त

words.sanskrit: vamana-annam iva pravrittim sarvam heyam matva sannyasyati sah jnana-sannyasi

meaning.en: regarding all activity as to be given up like vomited food -- he is the knowledge-renunciate
meaning.hi: वमन-अन्न सम प्रवृत्ति को त्याज्य मान संन्यास लेने वाला ज्ञान-संन्यासी है

words.sanskrit: kramena sarvam abhyasya sarvam anubhuya jnana-vairagyabhyam svarupanusandhanena deha-matra-avashishtah sannyasya jatarupa-dharah bhavati

meaning.en: having practiced and experienced all in sequence, through knowledge and dispassion reflecting on his own nature until only the body remains, he renounces and goes naked
meaning.hi: क्रमशः अभ्यास व अनुभव कर, स्वरूप-चिन्तन से केवल शरीर शेष रहने पर दिगम्बर संन्यास लेता है

words.sanskrit: brahmacharyam samapya grihi bhutva vanaprastha-ashramam etya vairagya-abhave api ashrama-kramanusarena yah sannyasyati sah karma-sannyasi

meaning.en: one who, without real dispassion, follows the stages in order and renounces, is the formal-duty renunciate
meaning.hi: बिना वैराग्य आश्रम-क्रम से संन्यास लेने वाला कर्म-संन्यासी है

words.sanskrit: sah sannyasah shadvidhah bhavati kutichaka-bahudaka-hamsa-paramahamsa-turiyatita-avadhutah cheti

meaning.en: this renunciation is six-fold: hut-dweller, bahudaka, hamsa, paramahamsa, turiyatita, avadhuta
meaning.hi: यह संन्यास छह प्रकार का है: कुटीचक, बहूदक, हंस, परमहंस, तुरीयातीत, अवधूत

words.sanskrit: kutichakah shikha-yajnopaviti danda-kamandalu-dharah

meaning.en: the hut-dweller keeps top-knot, thread, staff, water-pot
meaning.hi: कुटीचक शिखा, यज्ञोपवीत, दण्ड, जलपात्र रखता है

words.sanskrit: kaupina-shati-kantha-dharah pitri-matri-guru-aradhana-parah

meaning.en: wearing loincloth, wrap, patched cloth; devoted to serving parents and teacher
meaning.hi: कौपीन, वस्त्र, गुदड़ी पहने; माता-पिता-गुरु सेवा में लीन

words.sanskrit: shveta-urdhvapundra-dhari tridandah

meaning.en: wearing the white upward mark, a triple-staff ascetic
meaning.hi: श्वेत ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रधारी, त्रिदण्डी

words.sanskrit: bahudakah madhukara-vrittya ashtakavalashi

meaning.en: the bahudaka lives bee-like on gleanings, eight mouthfuls only
meaning.hi: बहूदक मधुकरवृत्ति से आठ ग्रास भर खाता है

words.sanskrit: hamsah jatadhari tripundra-urdhvapundra-dhari

meaning.en: the hamsa wears matted hair and the triple and upward marks
meaning.hi: हंस जटाधारी, त्रिपुण्ड्र-ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रधारी

words.sanskrit: paramahamsah shikha-yajnopavita-rahitah pancha-griheshu kara-patri

meaning.en: the paramahamsa is without top-knot or thread, cupped-hand alms at five houses
meaning.hi: परमहंस शिखा-यज्ञोपवीत रहित, पाँच घरों में करपात्री

words.sanskrit: sarvatyagi turiyatito go-mukha-vrittya phalahari deha-matra-avashishtah digambarah

meaning.en: renouncing all, beyond the fourth stage, grazing like a cow, only the body remains, naked
meaning.hi: सर्वत्यागी, तुरीयातीत, गोमुखवृत्ति, देहमात्रावशिष्ट, दिगम्बर

words.sanskrit: kunapavat sharira-vrittikah

meaning.en: he treats his body's maintenance as one treats a corpse
meaning.hi: अपने शरीर की वृत्ति को शव समान मानता है

words.sanskrit: avadhutah tu aniyamah patita-abhishasta-varjana-purvakam

meaning.en: the avadhuta is unbound by rule, save avoiding the fallen and the cursed
meaning.hi: अवधूत नियमरहित, पतित-अभिशप्त-वर्जन के सिवा

words.sanskrit: sarva-varneshu ajagara-vrittya ahara-parah svarupanusandhana-parah

meaning.en: python-like feeding among all classes, devoted to self-inquiry
meaning.hi: सब वर्णों में अजगरवृत्ति से भोजन, स्वरूपानुसन्धान में लीन

words.sanskrit: jagat tavat idam na aham sa-vriksha-trina-parvatam

meaning.en: this world, with its trees, grass, mountains -- I am not it
meaning.hi: यह जगत, वृक्ष-तृण-पर्वत सहित -- मैं यह नहीं

words.sanskrit: yat bahyam jadam atyantam tat syam katham aham vibhuh

meaning.en: what is external and utterly inert, how could I, all-pervading, be that?
meaning.hi: जो बाह्य और अत्यन्त जड़ है, वह मैं, सर्वव्यापी, कैसे होऊँ?

words.sanskrit: kalena alpena vilayi dehah na aham achetanah

meaning.en: in little time this body dissolves; I am not this unconscious thing
meaning.hi: थोड़े समय में यह शरीर विलीन होगा; मैं यह अचेतन नहीं

words.sanskrit: jadaya karna-shashkulya kalpamana-kshana-sthaya

meaning.en: like the unfeeling earlobe's motion, imagined to last a mere instant
meaning.hi: जड़ कर्ण-शष्कुली की भाँति, क्षणभर टिकने वाली कल्पित

words.sanskrit: shunya-akritih shunya-bhavah shabdah na aham achetanah

meaning.en: empty in form, empty in being -- sound; I am not this unconscious thing
meaning.hi: शून्य-आकृति, शून्य-भाव शब्द; मैं यह अचेतन नहीं

words.sanskrit: tvacha kshana-vinashinya prapyah aprapyah ayam anyatha

meaning.en: in skin that perishes in an instant, reachable and unreachable by turns
meaning.hi: क्षणविनाशिनी त्वचा में, कभी प्राप्य कभी अप्राप्य

words.sanskrit: chit-prasada-upalabdha-atma sparshah na aham achetanah

meaning.en: touch, grasped by the mind's clarity -- I am not this unconscious thing
meaning.hi: चित्त-प्रसाद से ग्रहित स्पर्श; मैं यह अचेतन नहीं

words.sanskrit: labdha-atma jihvaya tuccho lolaya lola-sattaya

meaning.en: grasped by a fickle, restless tongue's fickle being
meaning.hi: चंचल जिह्वा की चंचल सत्ता से ग्रहित

words.sanskrit: svalpa-syando dravya-nishthah rasah na aham achetanah

meaning.en: a scant trickle bound to substance -- taste; I am not this unconscious thing
meaning.hi: पदार्थ में स्थित क्षीण बूँद रस; मैं यह अचेतन नहीं

words.sanskrit: drishya-darshanayoh linam kshayi-kshana-vinashinoh

meaning.en: dissolved in the seen and the seeing, both perishing in an instant
meaning.hi: दृश्य-दर्शन में लीन, दोनों क्षणविनाशी

words.sanskrit: kevale drashtari kshinam rupam na aham achetanam

meaning.en: form, narrowed to the seer alone -- I am not this unconscious thing
meaning.hi: द्रष्टा तक सीमित रूप; मैं यह अचेतन नहीं

words.sanskrit: nasaya gandha-jadaya kshayinya parikalpitah

meaning.en: imagined by a nose perishable and dull, undone by scent
meaning.hi: जड़ क्षयिणी नासिका द्वारा कल्पित

words.sanskrit: pelavo niyata-akarah gandhah na aham achetanah

meaning.en: delicate, fixed in shape -- fragrance; I am not this unconscious thing
meaning.hi: नाज़ुक, नियत आकार गन्ध; मैं यह अचेतन नहीं

words.sanskrit: nirmamo amananah shanto gata-panchendriya-bhramah

meaning.en: possessionless, unaware, at peace, past the five senses' illusion
meaning.hi: निर्मम, अमनन, शान्त, पंचेन्द्रिय-भ्रम रहित

words.sanskrit: shuddha-chetana eva aham kala-kalana-varjitah

meaning.en: I am pure consciousness alone, free of any trace of quality
meaning.hi: मैं शुद्ध चेतना ही, कला-कलन रहित

words.sanskrit: chaitya-varjita-chinmatram aham eshah avabhasakah

meaning.en: I am this pure consciousness free of the perceived, the illuminator itself
meaning.hi: चैत्य-वर्जित चिन्मात्र, यह अवभासक मैं ही हूँ

words.sanskrit: sa-bahya-abhyantara-vyapi nishkalah aham niranjanah

meaning.en: pervading inside and out, whole, untainted, am I
meaning.hi: बाह्य-आभ्यन्तर व्यापी, निष्कल, निरंजन मैं

words.sanskrit: nirvikalpa-chit-abhasah ekah atma asmi sarvagah

meaning.en: the undivided reflection of consciousness, one self, present everywhere
meaning.hi: निर्विकल्प चिदाभास, एक आत्मा, सर्वगः

words.sanskrit: maya eva chetanena ime sarve ghata-patadayah

meaning.en: by this very consciousness, all these pots, cloths and so on
meaning.hi: इसी चेतना से ये सब घट-पट आदि

words.sanskrit: surya-antah avabhasyante dipena iva atma-tejasa

meaning.en: up to the sun are made visible, like by a lamp's own light
meaning.hi: सूर्य तक दीपक के अपने तेज की भाँति प्रकट किए जाते

words.sanskrit: maya eva etah sphuranti iha vichitra-indriya-vrittayah

meaning.en: by this very consciousness these varied sense-activities come alive here
meaning.hi: इसी चेतना से यहाँ विविध इन्द्रिय-वृत्तियाँ सजीव होती हैं

words.sanskrit: tejasa antah-prakashena yatha agni-kana-panktayah

meaning.en: by the inner glow of its own light, like rows of fire-sparks
meaning.hi: अन्तः-प्रकाश के तेज से, अग्नि-कण-पंक्तियों की भाँति

words.sanskrit: ananta-ananda-sambhoga parah-upashama-shalini

meaning.en: of unending joyful experience, possessed of the deepest stillness
meaning.hi: अनन्त आनन्द-सम्भोग, परम उपशम से युक्त

words.sanskrit: shuddha iyam chinmayi drishtih jayati akhila-drishtishu

meaning.en: this pure vision of consciousness triumphs over all vision
meaning.hi: यह शुद्ध चिन्मयी दृष्टि सब दृष्टियों में विजयी है

words.sanskrit: sarva-bhava-antara-sthaya chaitya-mukta-chit-atmane

meaning.en: to the one standing beyond every state, consciousness freed of the perceived
meaning.hi: सब भावों से परे खड़े, चैत्य-मुक्त चित्-आत्मा को

words.sanskrit: pratyak-chaitanya-rupaya mahyam eva namo namah

meaning.en: to the form of inward consciousness -- to myself, salutation again and again
meaning.hi: प्रत्यक्-चैतन्य-रूप को, मुझे ही बार-बार प्रणाम

words.sanskrit: vichitrah shaktayah svachchhah samah ya nirvikaraya

meaning.en: varied powers, pure, equal, by that which is changeless
meaning.hi: विविध शक्तियाँ, स्वच्छ, सम, उस अविकारी से

words.sanskrit: chita kriyante samaya kala-kalana-muktaya

meaning.en: are created by consciousness, at peace, free of dividing marks
meaning.hi: चेतना द्वारा रची जातीं, समता-युक्त, कला-कलन-मुक्त

words.sanskrit: kala-trayam upekshitrya hinayah chaitya-bandhanaih

meaning.en: free of the three times' bonds, past what is merely perceived
meaning.hi: तीनों काल के बन्धनों से रहित, चैत्य-बन्धनों से परे

words.sanskrit: chitah chaityam upekshitryah samata eva avashishyate

meaning.en: once the perceived is set aside, only evenness remains
meaning.hi: चैत्य त्यागने पर केवल समता ही शेष रहती है

words.sanskrit: sa hi vacham agamyatvat asattam iva shashvatim

meaning.en: because beyond speech's reach, it seems like an eternal non-being
meaning.hi: वाणी की अगम्यता से यह शाश्वत अभाव-सी लगती

words.sanskrit: nairatmya-siddha-atma-dasham upayata eva shishyate

meaning.en: what remains, having reached the state where no separate self is left
meaning.hi: नैरात्म्य-सिद्ध आत्म-दशा को प्राप्त ही शेष रहती है

words.sanskrit: iha-anihamayaih antarya chit-avalita malaih

meaning.en: wrapped within by impurities born of striving and not-striving
meaning.hi: प्रयास-अप्रयास से उपजी मलिनताओं से भीतर लिपटी

words.sanskrit: sa chit na utpadayitum shakta pasha-baddha iva pakshini

meaning.en: this consciousness cannot shine openly, like a snared bird
meaning.hi: यह चेतना खुलकर प्रकट नहीं हो पाती, जाल में बँधे पक्षी सम

words.sanskrit: iccha-dvesha-samutthena dvandva-mohena jantavah

meaning.en: living beings, confused by the duality born of desire and aversion
meaning.hi: इच्छा-द्वेष से उत्पन्न द्वन्द्व-मोह से प्राणी

words.sanskrit: dhara-vivara-magnanam kitanam samatam gatah

meaning.en: come to resemble insects sunk inside a hole in the earth
meaning.hi: धरा-विवर में डूबे कीड़ों की समता को प्राप्त होते हैं

words.sanskrit: atmane astu namo mahyam avicchinna-chit-atmane

meaning.en: salutation to the self, to me, unbroken consciousness itself
meaning.hi: आत्मा को नमन, मुझे, अखण्ड चित्-आत्मा को

words.sanskrit: paramrishtah asmi labdhah asmi proditah asmi achirat aham

meaning.en: I have grasped, I have found, I have just now arisen
meaning.hi: मैंने ग्रहण किया, मैंने पाया, मैं अभी उठा

words.sanskrit: uddhritah asmi vikalpebhyah yah asmi sah asmi namah astu te

meaning.en: I am lifted from uncertainty; who I am, that I am; salutation to you
meaning.hi: मैं संशय से उद्धृत; जो हूँ सो हूँ; तुझे नमन

words.sanskrit: tubhyam mahyam anantaya mahyam tubhyam chid-atmane

meaning.en: to you, to me, the infinite; to me, to you, consciousness itself
meaning.hi: तुझे, मुझे, अनन्त को; मुझे, तुझे, चित्-आत्मा को

words.sanskrit: namah tubhyam paresha ya namah mahyam shivaya cha

meaning.en: salutation to you, supreme lord; salutation to me, the source of good
meaning.hi: तुझे नमन, परमेश्वर को; मुझे नमन, शिव को

words.sanskrit: tishthan api hi na asino gacchan api na gacchati

meaning.en: though standing not seated, though walking not going
meaning.hi: खड़ा होकर भी न बैठा, चलकर भी न जाता

words.sanskrit: shantah api vyavahara-sthah kurvan api na lipyate

meaning.en: though at peace, engaged in dealings; though acting, untouched
meaning.hi: शान्त होकर भी व्यवहार-स्थ, कर्म करके भी अलिप्त

words.sanskrit: sulabhah cha ayam atyantam sujneyah cha apta-bandhuvat

meaning.en: he is very easy to reach, easy to know, like a trusted friend
meaning.hi: वह अत्यन्त सुलभ, आप्त-बन्धु सम सुज्ञेय

words.sanskrit: sharira-padma-kuhare sarvesham eva shatpadah

meaning.en: the bee in the hollow of every body's lotus, for all equally
meaning.hi: हर शरीर-कमल के कोष में सबके लिए समान षट्पद

words.sanskrit: na me bhoga-sthitau vancha na me bhoga-visarjane

meaning.en: I have no wish for things to remain, none for them to leave
meaning.hi: मुझे स्थिति की चाह नहीं, विसर्जन की भी नहीं

words.sanskrit: yat ayati tat ayatu yat prayati prayatu tat

meaning.en: let what comes, come; let what goes, go
meaning.hi: जो आए सो आए, जो जाए सो जाए

words.sanskrit: manasa manasi chchinne nirahankaram gate

meaning.en: when mind dissolves in mind, the ego-sense gone
meaning.hi: मन में मन के छिन्न होने पर, निरहंकार होने पर

words.sanskrit: bhavena galite bhave svasthah tishthami kevalah

meaning.en: the notion of state having melted, I remain alone, whole
meaning.hi: भाव के गलित होने पर, स्वस्थ अकेला रहता हूँ

words.sanskrit: nirbhavam nirahankaram nirmanaskam aniritam

meaning.en: free of state, free of ego, free of mind, wishing nothing
meaning.hi: निर्भाव, निरहंकार, निर्मनस्क, अनीहित

words.sanskrit: kevala-aspanda-shuddha-atmani eva tishthati me ripuh

meaning.en: in the self's own unmoving purity alone my enemy stays trapped
meaning.hi: केवल अस्पन्द शुद्ध आत्मा में ही मेरा शत्रु टिका रहता है

words.sanskrit: trishna-rajju-ganam chittva mat-sharira-kapanjarat

meaning.en: cutting the rope woven of craving, from the cage of my body
meaning.hi: तृष्णा-रज्जु काटकर, मेरे शरीर-पिंजर से

words.sanskrit: na jane kva gatah uddiya nirahankara-pakshini

meaning.en: I do not know where the egoless bird has flown
meaning.hi: मैं नहीं जानता निरहंकार पक्षिणी कहाँ उड़ गई

words.sanskrit: yasya na ahamkrito bhavo buddhih yasya na lipyate

meaning.en: one with no sense of being a particular self, whose understanding is untouched
meaning.hi: जिसमें अहंकृत भाव नहीं, जिसकी बुद्धि लिप्त नहीं होती

words.sanskrit: yah samah sarva-bhuteshu jivitam tasya shobhate

meaning.en: who is equal toward all beings -- that one's life becomes beautiful
meaning.hi: जो सब भूतों में समान है -- उसका जीवन शोभित होता है

words.sanskrit: yah antah-shitalaya buddhya raga-dvesha-vimuktaya

meaning.en: who, with an inwardly cooled understanding free of attraction and aversion
meaning.hi: जो भीतर से शीतल, राग-द्वेष-मुक्त बुद्धि से

words.sanskrit: sakshivat pashyati idam hi jivitam tasya shobhate

meaning.en: sees all this as a witness -- that one's life becomes beautiful
meaning.hi: साक्षी सम यह देखता है -- उसका जीवन शोभित होता है

words.sanskrit: yena samyak parijnaya heya-upadeyam ujjhata

meaning.en: by whom, having rightly discerned what to pursue and release
meaning.hi: जिसने हेय-उपादेय ठीक जानकर

words.sanskrit: chittasya ante arpitam chittam jivitam tasya shobhate

meaning.en: the mind rests at its own final settling -- that one's life becomes beautiful
meaning.hi: चित्त अपने अन्त में स्थिर हुआ -- उसका जीवन शोभित होता है

words.sanskrit: grahya-grahaka-sambandhe kshine shantih udeti alam

meaning.en: when the bond of grasped and grasper wears thin, peace rises fully
meaning.hi: ग्राह्य-ग्राहक बन्ध क्षीण होने पर शान्ति पूर्णतः उदित होती है

words.sanskrit: sthitim abhyagata shantih moksha-nama abhidhiyate

meaning.en: peace, having reached a lasting state, is called liberation
meaning.hi: स्थिति को प्राप्त शान्ति मोक्ष नाम से कही जाती है

words.sanskrit: bhrashta-bija-upama bhuyo janma-ankura-vivarjita

meaning.en: like a burnt seed, free of any further sprout or birth
meaning.hi: भ्रष्ट-बीज सम, अंकुर-जन्म रहित

words.sanskrit: hridi jivad-vimuktanam shuddha bhavati vasana

meaning.en: in the heart of those liberated while alive, the tendency becomes pure
meaning.hi: जीवन्मुक्तों के हृदय में वासना शुद्ध होती है

words.sanskrit: pavani parama-udara shuddha-sattva-anupatini

meaning.en: purifying, supremely generous, following pure and settled being
meaning.hi: पावन, परम उदार, शुद्ध-सत्त्वानुपाती

words.sanskrit: atma-dhyanamayi nitya sushupti-stheva tishthati

meaning.en: ever devoted to self-reflection, it stays as if held in deep sleep
meaning.hi: आत्म-ध्यानमयी नित्य सुषुप्तिस्थ सी टिकी रहती है

words.sanskrit: chetanam chitta-riktam hi pratyak-chetanam uchyate

meaning.en: consciousness emptied of mind-content is called the inward consciousness
meaning.hi: चित्तरिक्त चेतना प्रत्यक्-चेतना कहलाती है

words.sanskrit: nirmanaska-svabhavatvat na tatra kalanam malam

meaning.en: because its nature is mindlessness, no trace of activity there
meaning.hi: निर्मनस्क स्वभाव से वहाँ कलना का मैल नहीं

words.sanskrit: sa satyata sa shivata sa avastha paramatmiki

meaning.en: that is truth, that is auspiciousness, that is the supreme self's state
meaning.hi: वह सत्यता, वह शिवता, वह परमात्मिकी अवस्था

words.sanskrit: sarvajnata sa santriptih na tu yatra manah kshatam

meaning.en: that is omniscience, that is contentment -- not where the mind is wounded
meaning.hi: वह सर्वज्ञता, वह सन्तृप्ति -- न कि जहाँ मन क्षत हो

words.sanskrit: pralapan visrijan grihnan unmishan nimishan api

meaning.en: speaking, releasing, grasping, opening the eyes, closing them
meaning.hi: बोलते, छोड़ते, ग्रहण करते, खोलते, मूँदते

words.sanskrit: nirasta-manana-anandah sanvinmatra-parah asmi aham

meaning.en: mind's workings cast aside, I am nothing but pure joyful knowing
meaning.hi: मनन-रहित आनन्द, संविन्मात्र-पर मैं ही हूँ

words.sanskrit: malam samvedyam utsrijya mano nirmulayan param

meaning.en: setting aside the impurity felt as object, uprooting the mind entirely
meaning.hi: संवेद्य मल त्यागकर मन को समूल उखाड़कर

words.sanskrit: asha-pashan alam chittva sanvinmatra-parah asmi aham

meaning.en: cutting the noose of hope fully, I am nothing but pure joyful knowing
meaning.hi: आशा-पाश काटकर, संविन्मात्र-पर मैं ही हूँ

words.sanskrit: ashubha-ashubha-sankalpah sanshantah asmi niramayah

meaning.en: good and bad intention settled, I am free of illness
meaning.hi: अशुभ-शुभ संकल्प शान्त, मैं निरामय हूँ

words.sanskrit: nashta-ishta-anishta-kalanah sanmatra-parah asmi aham

meaning.en: notions of desirable and undesirable destroyed, I am pure knowing
meaning.hi: इष्ट-अनिष्ट कलना नष्ट, सन्मात्र-पर मैं ही हूँ

words.sanskrit: atma-tapa-rate tyaktva nirvibhago jagat-sthitau

meaning.en: setting aside the world bound to the self, undivided in the world's being
meaning.hi: आत्म-बद्ध जगत त्यागकर, जगत-स्थिति में अविभक्त

words.sanskrit: vajra-stambhavat atmanam avalambya sthirah asmi aham

meaning.en: resting on the self as on an unbreakable pillar, I remain steady
meaning.hi: वज्र-स्तम्भ सम आत्मा का सहारा लेकर स्थिर हूँ

words.sanskrit: nirmalayam nirashayam svasamvittau sthitah asmi aham

meaning.en: in stainless, longing-free self-awareness, I remain established
meaning.hi: निर्मल, निराश स्वसंवित्ति में मैं स्थित हूँ

words.sanskrit: ihita-anihitaih muktah heya-upadeya-varjitah

meaning.en: free of what is sought and avoided, released from both
meaning.hi: ईहित-अनीहित से मुक्त, हेय-उपादेय रहित

words.sanskrit: kada antah tosham eshyami sva-prakasha-pade sthitah

meaning.en: when will I reach that inner contentment, established in my self-luminous ground
meaning.hi: कब मैं स्वप्रकाश-पद में स्थित परम सन्तोष पाऊँगा

words.sanskrit: kada upashanta-manano dharani-dhara-kandare

meaning.en: when, my mind stilled, in the mountain's own cave
meaning.hi: कब, मन शान्त होकर, पर्वत की गुफा में

words.sanskrit: sameshyami shila-samyam nirvikalpa-samadhina

meaning.en: will I reach the equality of stone through thought-free absorption
meaning.hi: क्या मैं निर्विकल्प समाधि से शिला-सम पाऊँगा

words.sanskrit: niramsha-dhyana-vishrantim mukasya mama mastake

meaning.en: the rest of undivided meditation upon my silent head
meaning.hi: निरंश ध्यान की विश्रान्ति मेरे मौन मस्तक पर

words.sanskrit: kada tarnam karishyanti kulayam vana-putrikah

meaning.en: when will the little forest birds make a nest of straw
meaning.hi: कब वनपुत्रिकाएँ तिनकों का घोंसला बनाएँगी

words.sanskrit: sankalpa-padapam trishna-latam chittva mano-vanam

meaning.en: having felled the tree of intention, cut the creeper of craving, in the mind's forest
meaning.hi: संकल्प-वृक्ष गिराकर, तृष्णा-लता काटकर, मनोवन में

words.sanskrit: vitatam bhuvam asadya viharami yatha-sukham

meaning.en: having reached the open expanse, I roam at ease
meaning.hi: विस्तृत भूमि पाकर सुखपूर्वक विचरता हूँ

words.sanskrit: padam tad anu yatah asmi kevalah asmi jayami aham

meaning.en: having reached that place, alone and complete, I am victorious
meaning.hi: उस पद को पाकर, केवल होकर, मैं विजयी हूँ

words.sanskrit: nirvanah asmi nirihah asmi niramshah asmi niripsitah

meaning.en: I am extinguished, wishless, undivided, free of longing
meaning.hi: मैं निर्वाण, निरीह, निरंश, निरीप्सित हूँ

words.sanskrit: svachchha-urjitata satta hridyata satyata jnata

meaning.en: pure vitality, being, inner richness, truth, knowing
meaning.hi: स्वच्छ ऊर्जितता, सत्ता, हृद्यता, सत्यता, ज्ञता

words.sanskrit: anandita-upashamata sada pramudita-udita

meaning.en: joyful stillness, ever risen in delight
meaning.hi: आनन्दित उपशम, सदा प्रमुदित उदित

words.sanskrit: purnata-udarata satya kanti-satta sada-ikata

meaning.en: true fullness, generosity, radiant being, eternal oneness
meaning.hi: पूर्णता, उदारता, कान्ति-सत्ता, सदा एकता

words.sanskrit: iti evam chintayan bhikshuh svarupa-sthitim anjasa

meaning.en: thus reflecting, the mendicant, quickly on his own nature
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार चिन्तन करते भिक्षु ने शीघ्र स्वरूप-स्थिति को

words.sanskrit: nirvikalpa-svarupa-jno nirvikalpah babhuva ha

meaning.en: knowing the undivided nature, he himself became undivided
meaning.hi: निर्विकल्प स्वरूप जानकर वह निर्विकल्प हो गया

words.sanskrit: aturah jivati chet krama-sannyasah kartavyah

meaning.en: if gravely ill, an abbreviated renunciation should be undertaken
meaning.hi: आतुर जीवित हो तो क्रम-संन्यास करना चाहिए

words.sanskrit: na shudra-stri-patita-udakya sambhashanam

meaning.en: no speaking with shudra, woman, fallen, or menstruating woman
meaning.hi: शूद्र-स्त्री-पतित-रजस्वला से वार्तालाप नहीं

words.sanskrit: tasmat na sannyasinah esha lokah

meaning.en: therefore this world does not belong to the renunciate
meaning.hi: अतः यह लोक संन्यासी का नहीं

words.sanskrit: aturakutichakayoh bhuloka-bhuvarlokau bahudakasya svargalokah

meaning.en: the emergency ascetic and hut-dweller's domain is earth and the next; the bahudaka's is the heavenly world
meaning.hi: आतुर-कुटीचक का भूलोक-भुवर्लोक; बहूदक का स्वर्गलोक

words.sanskrit: hamsasya tapolokah paramahamsasya satyalokah

meaning.en: the hamsa's is the world of austerity; the paramahamsa's is the world of truth
meaning.hi: हंस का तपोलोक; परमहंस का सत्यलोक

words.sanskrit: svarupanusandhana-vyatirikta anya-shastra-abhyasa ushtra-kunkuma-bharavat vyarthah

meaning.en: study apart from self-inquiry is as pointless as loading a camel with saffron
meaning.hi: स्वरूपानुसन्धान के बिना अन्य शास्त्राभ्यास ऊँट पर केसर-भार सा व्यर्थ

words.sanskrit: na yoga-shastra-pravrittih na sankhya-shastra-abhyasah

meaning.en: no place for yoga practice, no place for Sankhya study
meaning.hi: योगशास्त्र-प्रवृत्ति नहीं, सांख्यशास्त्राभ्यास नहीं

words.sanskrit: asti chet shava-alankaravat karma achara vidya-durah

meaning.en: if he does, treat it like decorating a corpse, far from understanding
meaning.hi: करे तो शव-अलंकार सम, विद्या से दूर

words.sanskrit: na parivrat nama-sankirtana-parah yat yat karma karoti tat tat phalam anubhavati

meaning.en: the mendicant has no point in chanting names; whatever action, its fruit is experienced
meaning.hi: परिव्राजक का नाम-संकीर्तन में प्रयोजन नहीं; जो कर्म वह फल भोगता है

words.sanskrit: eranda-taila-phenavat sarvam parityajet

meaning.en: he should give up everything like the foam on castor oil
meaning.hi: एरण्ड-तैल-फेन सम सब त्याग दे

words.sanskrit: madhukara-vrittya aharam aharan krishibhutva medovriddhim akurvan viharet

meaning.en: gathering food bee-like, staying lean, never gaining fat, he should live
meaning.hi: मधुकरवृत्ति से भोजन कर, दुबला रह, चर्बी न बढ़ाते हुए विचरे

words.sanskrit: madhukarena kara-patrena asya-patrena va kalam nayet

meaning.en: he should pass his time on gleanings, by cupped hand or by mouth
meaning.hi: मधुकर से, करपात्र या आस्यपात्र से काल बिताए

words.sanskrit: atma-sammitam aharam aharet atmavan yatih

meaning.en: the self-possessed ascetic should eat food proportionate to himself
meaning.hi: आत्मवान यति आत्म-सम्मित आहार करे

words.sanskrit: aharasya cha bhagau dvau tritiyam udakasya cha vayoh sancharanartham chaturtham avashesayet

meaning.en: two parts food, a third water, leaving a fourth for air's movement
meaning.hi: दो भाग अन्न, तीसरा जल, चौथा वायु-संचार हेतु शेष रखे

words.sanskrit: bhaikshena vartayet nityam na eka-annashi bhavet kvachit

meaning.en: he should live daily by alms, never eating only at one household
meaning.hi: नित्य भैक्ष्य से जिए, कभी एकान्नाशी न बने

words.sanskrit: nirikshante tu anudvignah tad-griham yatnatah vrajet

meaning.en: watching without visible agitation, he should carefully approach that house
meaning.hi: अनुद्विग्न देखकर उस घर को यत्न से जाए

words.sanskrit: pancha-sapta-grihanam tu bhiksham ichchhet kriyavatam

meaning.en: he should seek alms of five to seven households of the diligent
meaning.hi: क्रियावानों के पाँच-सात घरों में भिक्षा चाहे

words.sanskrit: go-doha-matram akankshen nishkrantah na punah vrajet

meaning.en: hoping no more than a cow's milking-time, not returning once departed
meaning.hi: गोदोहमात्र की आशा रखे, निष्क्रान्त हो पुनः न जाए

words.sanskrit: naktat varah cha upavasah upavasat ayachitah

meaning.en: missing a meal is better than a fast, a fast better than the unrequested
meaning.hi: नक्त से उपवास श्रेष्ठ, उपवास से अयाचित

words.sanskrit: ayachitat varam bhaikshyam tasmat bhaikshyena vardhayet

meaning.en: the unrequested better than outright begging; alms should sustain him above all
meaning.hi: अयाचित से भैक्ष्य श्रेष्ठ, अतः भैक्ष्य से निर्वाह करे

words.sanskrit: na eva savyapasavyena bhiksha-kale vishet grihan

meaning.en: he should not enter houses by a fixed right-left pattern at alms-time
meaning.hi: भिक्षाकाल में सव्य-अपसव्य क्रम से घरों में न घुसे

words.sanskrit: na atikramet griham mohat yatra doshah na vidyate

meaning.en: he should not, from confusion, pass by a house with no real objection
meaning.hi: मोह से उस घर को न लाँघे जहाँ दोष न हो

words.sanskrit: shrotriya-annam na bhikshet shraddha-bhakti-bahishkritam

meaning.en: he should not accept a scholar's food if devoid of faith and devotion
meaning.hi: श्रद्धा-भक्ति रहित श्रोत्रिय का अन्न न भिक्षे

words.sanskrit: vratyasya api grihe bhikshet shraddha-bhakti-puraskrite

meaning.en: even at an uninitiated one's house, he may accept if faith and devotion lead
meaning.hi: व्रात्य के घर भी श्रद्धा-भक्ति-पुरस्कृत हो तो भिक्षे

words.sanskrit: madhukaram asanklriptam prak-pranitam ayachitam

meaning.en: bee-gathered, unclaimed, prepared beforehand, unrequested
meaning.hi: मधुकर, असंक्लृप्त, प्राक्प्रणीत, अयाचित

words.sanskrit: tatkalikam cha upapannam bhaiksham panchavidham smritam

meaning.en: arriving at the right time, and specifically arranged -- alms are five kinds
meaning.hi: तात्कालिक और उपपन्न -- भैक्ष्य पाँच प्रकार माना गया

words.sanskrit: manah-sankalpa-rahitan trin grihan pancha sapta va

meaning.en: three, five, or seven houses, free of mental calculation
meaning.hi: मनःसंकल्परहित तीन, पाँच, या सात घर

words.sanskrit: madhu-makshikavat kritva madhukaram iti smritam

meaning.en: done as a honeybee does -- this is called bee-gathering
meaning.hi: मधुमक्षिका सम किया गया मधुकर कहा गया

words.sanskrit: pratah-kale cha purvedyuh yat bhaktaih prathitam muhuh

meaning.en: what householders set aside the previous morning, hoping repeatedly
meaning.hi: पूर्वेद्युः प्रातःकाल भक्तों द्वारा बार-बार आशा से रखा गया

words.sanskrit: tat bhaiksham prak-pranitam syat sthitim kuryat tatha api va

meaning.en: that is alms prepared beforehand; he may accept or repeat this same practice
meaning.hi: वह प्राक्प्रणीत भैक्ष्य है; वह स्वीकारे या वही स्थिति फिर अपनाए

words.sanskrit: bhikshatana-samudyogat yena kena nimantritam

meaning.en: whatever is offered by anyone during the alms-round
meaning.hi: भिक्षाटन-प्रयास में जो भी किसी से निमन्त्रित हो

words.sanskrit: ayachitam tu tat bhaiksham bhoktavyam cha mumukshubhih

meaning.en: that unrequested alms should be eaten by those seeking liberation
meaning.hi: वह अयाचित भैक्ष्य मुमुक्षुओं द्वारा भोगने योग्य है

words.sanskrit: upasthanena yat proktam bhikshartham brahmanena tat

meaning.en: what a Brahmin declares at hand, meant for alms
meaning.hi: जो ब्राह्मण उपस्थान में भिक्षार्थ कहे

words.sanskrit: tatkalikam iti khyatam bhoktavyam yatibhih tada

meaning.en: this is known as alms at the right moment; renunciates should eat it
meaning.hi: यह तात्कालिक कहलाता है; यतियों को इसे भोगना चाहिए

words.sanskrit: siddham annam yad anitam brahmanena matham prati

meaning.en: cooked food brought by a Brahmin to the ashram
meaning.hi: ब्राह्मण द्वारा मठ में लाया गया सिद्ध अन्न

words.sanskrit: upapannam iti prahuh munayah moksha-kankshinah

meaning.en: sages who long for liberation call this specifically arranged alms
meaning.hi: मोक्षाकांक्षी मुनि इसे उपपन्न कहते हैं

words.sanskrit: charet madhukaram bhaiksham yatih mlechcha-kulad api

meaning.en: the ascetic should gather bee-like alms even from a low family
meaning.hi: यति निम्न कुल से भी मधुकरी भैक्ष्य करे

words.sanskrit: eka-annam natu bhunjita brihaspati-samat api

meaning.en: he should not eat at one household even if it equals the teacher of gods
meaning.hi: बृहस्पति-सम भी एकान्न न भोगे

words.sanskrit: yachita-ayachitabhyam cha bhikshabhyam kalpayet sthitam

meaning.en: he should shape his sustenance from both requested and unrequested alms
meaning.hi: याचित-अयाचित भिक्षाओं से स्थिति कल्पित करे

words.sanskrit: na vayuh sparsha-doshena na agnih dahana-karmana

meaning.en: wind is not faulted by touch, fire not by burning
meaning.hi: वायु स्पर्श-दोष से नहीं, अग्नि दहन-कर्म से नहीं

words.sanskrit: na apah mutra-purishabhyam na anna-doshena maskari

meaning.en: water not by urine and excrement; the mendicant not by faults in food
meaning.hi: जल मूत्र-पुरीष से नहीं, भिक्षु अन्न-दोष से नहीं

words.sanskrit: vidhume sanna-musale vyangare bhuktavajjane

meaning.en: when smoke has settled, the pestle silent, embers dim, people fed
meaning.hi: धुआँ शान्त, मूसल थमी, अंगारे मन्द, लोग भोजित

words.sanskrit: kale aparahne bhuyishthe bhikshacharanam acharet

meaning.en: in the latter part of the afternoon, he should go seeking alms
meaning.hi: अपराह्न में भिक्षाचरण करे

words.sanskrit: abhishastam cha patitam pashandam devapujakam

meaning.en: the cursed, the fallen, the heretic, the worshipper of images
meaning.hi: अभिशप्त, पतित, पाषण्ड, देवपूजक

words.sanskrit: varjayitva charet bhaiksham sarva-varneshu cha apadi

meaning.en: avoiding these, he may seek alms across all classes, even from them in distress
meaning.hi: इन्हें वर्जित कर सब वर्णों में, आपदि इनसे भी भिक्षे

words.sanskrit: ghritam sva-mutra-sadrisham madhu syat suraya samam

meaning.en: ghee equal to one's own urine, honey equal to liquor
meaning.hi: घृत स्वमूत्र सदृश, मधु सुरा समान

words.sanskrit: tailam sukara-mutram syat supam lashuna-sammitam

meaning.en: oil equal to pig's urine, a rich preparation equal to garlic
meaning.hi: तैल शूकरमूत्र सम, सूप लशुन-संमित

words.sanskrit: masha-udashadi go-mamsam kshiram mutra-samam bhavet

meaning.en: beans and such equal beef; milk equal to urine
meaning.hi: माष आदि गोमांस सम, क्षीर मूत्र सम

words.sanskrit: tasmat sarva-prayatnena ghritadin varjayet yatih

meaning.en: therefore with every effort the ascetic should avoid ghee and such
meaning.hi: अतः सर्वप्रयत्न से यति घृतादि वर्जे

words.sanskrit: patram asya bhavet panih tena nityam sthitim nayet

meaning.en: his vessel should be his hand; by it he sustains himself continuously
meaning.hi: पात्र हस्त हो, उससे नित्य स्थिति करे

words.sanskrit: pani-patrah charan yogi na asakrit bhaiksham acharet

meaning.en: the hand-vessel practitioner should not go on the alms-round repeatedly
meaning.hi: पाणिपात्र योगी बार-बार भैक्ष्य न करे

words.sanskrit: asyena tu yad aharam govat mrigayate munih

meaning.en: when the sage seeks food by mouth alone, as a cow grazes
meaning.hi: मुनि गोवत मुख से आहार ढूँढ़े

words.sanskrit: tada samah syat sarveshu sah amritatvaya kalpate

meaning.en: then he becomes equal to all, and fit for immortality
meaning.hi: तब सर्वत्र सम हो अमृतत्व योग्य बने

words.sanskrit: ajyam rudhiram iva tyajet ekatra annam palalam iva

meaning.en: give up ghee like blood, mixed food like decaying flesh
meaning.hi: आज्य रुधिर सम त्यागे, एकत्र अन्न पलल सम

words.sanskrit: prapancha-vrittim parityajya jivan-muktah bhavet

meaning.en: renouncing worldly activity entirely, he should become liberated while alive
meaning.hi: प्रपंचवृत्ति त्यागकर जीवन्मुक्त बने

words.sanskrit: asanam patra-lopah cha sanchayah shishya-sanchayah

meaning.en: a seat, discarding the vessel, accumulation, gathering disciples
meaning.hi: आसन, पात्रलोप, संचय, शिष्यसंचय

words.sanskrit: divasvapo vritha-lapo yateh bandhakarani shat

meaning.en: daytime sleep, idle talk -- six things bind the ascetic
meaning.hi: दिवास्वाप, वृथालाप -- यति के छह बन्धक

words.sanskrit: varshabhyah anyatra yat sthanam asanam tat udahritam

meaning.en: the place occupied apart from the rains is called a fixed seat
meaning.hi: वर्षा के अतिरिक्त स्थान आसन कहा गया

words.sanskrit: utkala-abvadi-patranam ekasya api iha sangrahah

meaning.en: gathering even one vessel for rice-water and such counts too
meaning.hi: उत्काल-अब्वादि पात्र का संग्रह भी यही है

words.sanskrit: yateh sanvyavaharaya patra-lopah sah uchyate

meaning.en: for the ascetic's daily use, this is called discarding the vessel
meaning.hi: यति के व्यवहार हेतु यह पात्रलोप कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: grihitasya tu dandadeh dvitiyasya parigrahah

meaning.en: namely the acceptance of a second staff or the like
meaning.hi: गृहीत दण्डादि के द्वितीय का परिग्रह

words.sanskrit: kalantara-upabhogartham sanchayah parikirtitah

meaning.en: accumulation is defined as gathering for future enjoyment
meaning.hi: कालान्तर-उपभोगार्थ संचय कीर्तित है

words.sanskrit: shishranam natu karunyat shishya-sangraha iritah

meaning.en: gathering disciples out of compassion is not what is meant
meaning.hi: करुणा से शिष्य-संग्रह अभिप्रेत नहीं

words.sanskrit: vidya-adiva prakashatvat avidya ratrih uchyate

meaning.en: knowledge is like light, ignorance is called night
meaning.hi: विद्या प्रकाशवत्, अविद्या रात्रि कही गई

words.sanskrit: vidya-abhyase pramadah yah sah divasvapa uchyate

meaning.en: negligence in the study of knowledge is called sleeping in the day
meaning.hi: विद्याभ्यास में प्रमाद ही दिवास्वाप कहा गया

words.sanskrit: adhyatmikim katham muktva bhiksha-vartam vina tatha

meaning.en: apart from spiritual discourse and alms-related talk
meaning.hi: अध्यात्मिक कथा और भिक्षावार्ता के अतिरिक्त

words.sanskrit: anugraham pariprashnam vritha-jalpah anyah uchyate

meaning.en: asking about a favor given is called the other idle talk
meaning.hi: अनुग्रह के प्रति प्रश्न वृथाजल्प कहा गया

words.sanskrit: eka-annam mada-matsaryam gandha-pushpa-vibhushanam

meaning.en: eating at one house, competitive pride, adornment with fragrance and flowers
meaning.hi: एकान्न, मद-मात्सर्य, गन्ध-पुष्प-विभूषण

words.sanskrit: tambula-abhyanjane krida bhoga-akanksha rasayanam

meaning.en: betel and oil, games, longing for pleasure, alchemy
meaning.hi: ताम्बूल-अभ्यंजन, क्रीड़ा, भोगाकांक्षा, रसायन

words.sanskrit: katthanam kutsanam svasti jyotish cha kraya-vikrayam

meaning.en: boasting, belittling, hollow well-wishing, astrology, buying and selling
meaning.hi: कत्थन, कुत्सन, स्वस्ति, ज्योतिष, क्रय-विक्रय

words.sanskrit: kriya-karma-vivadah cha guru-vakya-vilanghanam

meaning.en: disputes over ritual action, defying the teacher's word
meaning.hi: क्रिया-कर्म-विवाद, गुरु-वाक्य-विलंघन

words.sanskrit: sandhih cha vigrahah yanam manchakam shukla-vastrakam

meaning.en: alliance, hostility, riding a vehicle, a raised bed, white cloth
meaning.hi: सन्धि, विग्रह, यान, मंचक, शुक्लवस्त्र

words.sanskrit: naiva adadita patheyam yatih kinchit anapadi

meaning.en: the ascetic should take no provisions along except in crisis
meaning.hi: यति अनापदि पाथेय कुछ भी न ले

words.sanskrit: pakvam apatsu grihniyat yavat annam na labhyate

meaning.en: in emergencies he may accept cooked food, until fresh food is available
meaning.hi: आपत्सु पक्व ग्रहे जब तक अन्न न मिले

words.sanskrit: nirujah cha yuva cha eva bhikshuh na avasathe vaset

meaning.en: the healthy young mendicant should not dwell in a fixed place
meaning.hi: निरुज युवा भिक्षु आवसथ में न बसे

words.sanskrit: para-artham na pratigrahyam na dadyat cha kathanchana

meaning.en: nothing should be accepted on another's behalf, nor given away by him
meaning.hi: पर-अर्थ न प्रतिग्राह्य, न कथंचन दे

words.sanskrit: shukla-utsargo divasvapo bhiksha-adharah tu taijasam

meaning.en: formal waste-discharge, daytime sleep, a metal alms-vessel
meaning.hi: शुक्ल-उत्सर्ग, दिवास्वाप, तैजस भिक्षाधार

words.sanskrit: visham cha eva ayudham bijam hinsam taikshnyam cha maithunam

meaning.en: poison, weapon, seed, harm, sharpness, and sexual union
meaning.hi: विष, आयुध, बीज, हिंसा, तैक्ष्ण्य, मैथुन

words.sanskrit: tyaktam sannyasa-yogena griha-dharma-adikam vratam

meaning.en: given up through renunciation's yoga: household duty and its vow
meaning.hi: संन्यास-योग से त्यागा गृहधर्मादि व्रत

words.sanskrit: pratishiddhani cha etani sevamano vrajet adhah

meaning.en: these are prohibited; one who follows them slides downward
meaning.hi: ये प्रतिषिद्ध; सेवन करने वाला अधः जाए

words.sanskrit: sujirnah api sujirnasu vidvan strishu na vishvaset

meaning.en: even in truly aged women, the learned should not place trust
meaning.hi: सुजीर्ण स्त्रियों में भी विद्वान विश्वास न करे

words.sanskrit: sujirnasu api kanthasu sajjate jirnam ambaram

meaning.en: even to worn-soft patches, an old garment still clings
meaning.hi: सुजीर्ण कन्थाओं में भी जीर्ण वस्त्र सजता है

words.sanskrit: sthavaram jangamam bijam taijasam visham ayudham

meaning.en: immovable, moving, seed, metal-vessel, poison, weapon
meaning.hi: स्थावर, जंगम, बीज, तैजस, विष, आयुध

words.sanskrit: shad etani na grihniyat yatih mutra-purishavat

meaning.en: the ascetic should not take these six, as with urine and feces
meaning.hi: यति इन छहों को मूत्र-पुरीषवत् न ग्रहे

words.sanskrit: dainya-bhavat tu bhutanam saubhagaya yatih charet

meaning.en: out of humility toward beings, the ascetic should wander for his own good
meaning.hi: प्राणियों के प्रति दैन्य-भाव से यति सौभाग्य हेतु चरे

words.sanskrit: pakvam va yadi va apakvam yachamano vrajet adhah

meaning.en: whether cooked or uncooked -- if insistently begging, he slides downward
meaning.hi: पक्व या अपक्व, याचमान अधः जाए

words.sanskrit: anna-pana-parah bhikshuh vastradinam pratigrahi

meaning.en: focused on food and drink, the mendicant accepts cloth and such
meaning.hi: अन्न-पान-पर भिक्षु वस्त्रादि का प्रतिग्रही

words.sanskrit: avikam va anavikam va tatha patta-patan api

meaning.en: whether woolen or not, whether fine silk or woven cloth as well
meaning.hi: आविक या अनाविक, पट्टपट भी

words.sanskrit: pratigrihya yatih cha etan patati eva na sanshayah

meaning.en: the ascetic accepting these falls, without doubt
meaning.hi: यति इन्हें ग्रहण कर पतित हो, सन्देह नहीं

words.sanskrit: advaitam navam ashritya jivan-muktatvam apnuyat

meaning.en: resting on the boat of non-duality, he attains liberation while alive
meaning.hi: अद्वैत नाव का आश्रय ले जीवन्मुक्तत्व पाए

words.sanskrit: vag-dande maunam atishthet kaya-dande tu abhojanam

meaning.en: for speech-penance, silence; for body-penance, fasting
meaning.hi: वाग्दण्ड में मौन, कायदण्ड में अभोजन

words.sanskrit: manase tu krite dande pranayamah vidhiyate

meaning.en: when a mind-penance is done, breath-control is enjoined
meaning.hi: मानस दण्ड में प्राणायाम विहित

words.sanskrit: karmana badhyate jantuh vidyaya cha vimuchyate

meaning.en: a creature is bound by action, freed by knowledge
meaning.hi: प्राणी कर्म से बँधता, विद्या से मुक्त होता

words.sanskrit: tasmat karma na kurvanti yatayah paradarshinah

meaning.en: therefore those ascetics who see through do not perform action
meaning.hi: अतः पारदर्शी यति कर्म नहीं करते

words.sanskrit: rathyayam bahu-vastrani bhiksha sarvatra labhyate

meaning.en: many garments on the road, alms found everywhere
meaning.hi: मार्ग में बहु वस्त्र, सर्वत्र भिक्षा

words.sanskrit: bhumih shayya asti vistirna yatayah kena duhkhitah

meaning.en: the earth is a spacious bed -- what could cause ascetics suffering?
meaning.hi: भूमि विस्तीर्ण शय्या -- यतियों को किससे दुख?

words.sanskrit: prapancham akhilam yah tu jnana-agnau juhuyat yatih

meaning.en: the ascetic who offers the whole world into the fire of knowledge
meaning.hi: जो यति सम्पूर्ण प्रपंच को ज्ञानाग्नि में हवन करे

words.sanskrit: atmani agnin samaropya sah agnihotri maha-yatih

meaning.en: placing the fires in the self, he is the true fire-keeper, the greatest ascetic
meaning.hi: आत्मा में अग्नि स्थापित कर वह अग्निहोत्री महायति है

words.sanskrit: pravrittih dvividha prokta marjari cha eva vanari

meaning.en: engagement is two-fold, spoken of as the cat's way and the monkey's way
meaning.hi: प्रवृत्ति द्विविध कही गई, मार्जारी और वानरी

words.sanskrit: jnana-abhyasavatam motuh vanari-bhaktvam eva cha

meaning.en: among those practicing knowledge, being kitten-like alone applies
meaning.hi: ज्ञानाभ्यासवानों में मार्जार-भाव ही लागू

words.sanskrit: na aprishtah kasyachit bruyat na cha anyayena pricchatah

meaning.en: he should not speak unasked, nor to one who asks improperly
meaning.hi: अपृष्ट न बोले, अन्याय से पूछते को न बोले

words.sanskrit: jnan api hi medhavi jadavat lokam acharet

meaning.en: the wise, even while knowing, should conduct himself in the world as if dull
meaning.hi: मेधावी जानते हुए भी जड़वत् लोक में आचरे

words.sanskrit: sarvesham eva papanam sanghate samupasthite

meaning.en: when a whole mass of sins has genuinely accumulated
meaning.hi: सब पापों का संघात उपस्थित होने पर

words.sanskrit: taram dvadasha-sahasram abhyaset chedanam hi tat

meaning.en: he should practice the syllable twelve thousand times, for that truly cuts it
meaning.hi: तार का द्वादशसाहस्र अभ्यास करे, वही छेदन है

words.sanskrit: yah tu dvadasha-sahasram pranavam japate anvaham

meaning.en: whoever recites the syllable twelve thousand times each day
meaning.hi: जो प्रतिदिन द्वादशसाहस्र प्रणव जपे

words.sanskrit: tasya dvadashabhih masaih param brahma prakashate

meaning.en: for him, within twelve months, the supreme Brahman is revealed
meaning.hi: उसके लिए बारह महीनों में परम ब्रह्म प्रकाशित हो
